summary: Evofem Biosciences filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing a fifth amendment to its October 14, 2020 Securities Purchase Agreement with Adjuvant Global Health Technology Fund entities. The amendment moves the Notes' full-payable date to the earlier of December 1, 2026, an Adjuvant-elected Change of Control consummation, or Section 8 acceleration, and prohibits prepayment before December 1, 2026 absent Adjuvant consent, while removing certain Section 7.1 affirmative covenants. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is a routine debt-amendment current report, not a special situation; watch covenant relief and maturity/change-of-control dynamics.
